result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers see that the day of setup is the real cost and offer to do the setup for the prospect. Both also recommend agreed success criteria and screening prospects before starting a trial. A wins mainly because it gives a ready-to-send reply for prospects who ask to try it free, which B doesn't. A also states its position more cleanly, while B both says 'don't say yes to everyone' and 'say yes to all of them'. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers take a clear conditional position and see that setup is the real cost, so both offer to load the schedule for the prospect. B does more on the other items. It sets a written success test with named owners on each side and an end date, and it qualifies prospects by asking about their pain and who signs. It also gives wording to send the prospect, which A does not.
